entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'm calling because I need to return a pair of cycling shoes I bought a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Mark Shapiro, and the order number is VF88602.

Thank you, Mark. I've pulled up your order for the VeloFit Pro-Carbon cycling shoes, delivered... let's see... 59 days ago. To process this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's more of a fit issue. I've given them a fair try, but no matter how I position the cleats or what socks I wear, they're giving me terrible blisters on my heels. They just don't work for my feet.
I'm sorry to hear that, Mark. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment.

Okay, I've confirmed it. Since you received the shoes 59 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you. I'll email you a pre-paid shipping label right now.

A full refund sounds great, thank you. I do appreciate that. Now, since I did have to deal with the blisters and the trouble of testing them out, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for a future purchase? Maybe 15% off something else?

I understand you're looking for a bit extra for the inconvenience, and I'm glad we could approve the return. Our standard policy in this situation is to provide the full refund for the item, which covers the cost of the product. Unfortunately, we aren't able to add a promotional discount on top of that.
I see. So no goodwill credit or anything like that? It's just the straight refund?

That's correct. The full refund is the complete resolution we offer. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, the funds will be returned to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
Alright, fair enough. I had to ask. Please go ahead and send that label over. Thank you for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome, Mark. The email with the label is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
